body.description: weathered red barn with solar panels on the roof and vines, post-apocalyptic solarpunk, EXTREME high-angle top-down view seen from almost directly overhead, the large slanted roof seen from above fills most of the sprite, only a short front-wall strip with the door at the very bottom edge, both side walls completely hidden, perfectly symmetric mirror-image left and right half, flat top-down RPG overworld building roof tile, NOT isometric, NO side walls, NO 3D corner block, pixel art, transparent background
